title: Argentinian Empanadas
description: A delicious and crispy pastry filled with a savory mix of cheese and a hint of zesty flavor. Inspired by the classic empanadas of Argentina.

ingredients.name: Zesty Cheese Filling
ingredients.amount: 1 cup shredded cheese (Monterey Jack or similar)
ingredients.notes: Add some diced onions or bell peppers for extra flavor

ingredients.name: Salsa Criolla
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup salsa criolla (or similar Argentinian-style salsa)

instructions: Roll out the empanada dough and cut into 4 squares.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of the zesty cheese filling in the center of each square.
Fold the dough in half to form a triangle and press edges to seal.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of salsa criolla.
